notes.text: Codification Section, Pub. L. 97–399, § 2, Dec. 31, 1982, 96 Stat. 2012, which set out congressional findings and declaration of policy, was omitted from the Code as being of special and not general application.

Short TitlePub. L. 97–399, § 1, Dec. 31, 1982, 96 Stat. 2012, provided that Pub. L. 97–399, enacting this part A (§ 1741 et seq.) of this subchapter, could be cited as the “Florida Indian Land Claims Settlement Act of 1982”.
